verdict.rationale: Publishing guidance on non-US startup instruments is a fair question for a startup-focused law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a general Startup Resource Center and US-specific equity-compensation work (409A, 162(m), 280G). Nothing in the pack mentions UK EMI, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE or other non-US instruments, and the offices page lists only US locations.
